purpose: App HistoryBackend over the few-group-history idb store: durable, per-group seq-ordered, at-least-once sink that persists {entry, seq, dispatched}, dispatches accepted group rumors to injected app handlers (sender = orderingKey.account), retracts on withdraw, purges on teardown and re-dispatches undispatched rows in a startup sweep.

public_api.name: createHistoryBackend
public_api.signature: (options: { handlers: GroupHistoryHandlers; store?: HistoryStore; settleTimeoutMs?: number; onError?: (error: unknown, ctx: {groupId: string; eventId: string}) => void }) => AppHistoryBackend
public_api.description: Builds the sink. Throws TypeError when handlers (dispatch + retract) are missing.

public_api.name: AppHistoryBackend
public_api.description: append/withdraw/list/purge per library contract plus the startup sweep (call before groups.list()).

public_api.name: GroupHistoryHandlers
public_api.signature: { dispatch(input: GroupRumorInput): Promise<void>; retract(input: GroupRumorInput): Promise<void> }
public_api.description: Seam port. dispatch idempotent per (groupId,eventId) and throws on durable failure; retract of an unseen eventId is a no-op; neither awaits an account-scope client call.

public_api.name: GroupRumorInput
public_api.signature: { groupId: string; eventId: string; rumor: Rumor; sender: string }

public_api.name: HISTORY_SETTLE_TIMEOUT_MS
public_api.description: Per-call settle bound (matches the library's historyTimeoutMs default).

public_api.name: createIdbHistoryStore / getDefaultHistoryStore / HISTORY_DB_NAME
public_api.description: idb-keyval row store (get/set/del/delMany/keys/entries/createStore, no update()); lazy creation.

public_api.name: clearAllGroupHistory
public_api.description: Empties the default few-group-history store (clearAllGroupData / storeIncompatible wipe).

owned_data: idb database few-group-history (object store 'rows'): rows `${groupId}:${eventId}` -> {entry, seq, dispatched}; counters `#seq:${groupId}` -> number
